name: Moondragon
text: Dragon of the Moon — Action: Spend a [mental] resource and take 1 damage → Moondragon gets -3 THW and +3 ATK until the end of the round. (Limit once per round.)

name: Heather Douglas
text: Honed Mind — Action: Spend a [mental] resource → draw 1 card and heal 1 damage from Heather Douglas. (Limit once per round.)

flavor: “She's the woman I married. The super hero from the super hero dimension, doing what super heroes do. She's saving the day.” –Moondragon
name: Phyla-Vell
text: Response: After Phyla-Vell attacks and defeats an enemy, deal 1 damage to each enemy.

name: Dragon's Fury
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 7 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using a [mental] resource, this attack gains ranged and piercing. If you paid for this card using 2 or more [mental] resources, this attack also gains overkill. If you paid for this card using 3 or more [mental] resources, this attack deals an additional 3 damage.

name: Focus Beam
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using a [mental] resource, deal 2 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using 2 or more [mental] resources, deal 2 damage to an enemy.

name: Mental Dominance
text: Hero Action: Choose one of the following: • Heal 1 damage from Moondragon and draw 1 card. • Choose a minion. Remove threat from a scheme equal to that minion's SCH or it attacks another enemy of your choice.

name: Open Mindspace
text: Hero Interrupt: When a friendly character uses a basic power, they get +1 to that power for this use. If you paid for this card using a [mental] resource, ready that character.

name: Psionic Shield
text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage from an attack, prevent all of that damage. If you paid for this card using a [mental] resource, heal 1 damage from Moondragon. If you paid for this card using 2 or more [mental] resources, deal 2 damage to the attacking enemy.

name: Memory of Oblivion
text: Alter-Ego Action: Spend a [mental] resource and exhaust Memory of Oblivion → shuffle 3 different Moondragon cards from your discard pile into your deck.

name: Meeting of the Minds
text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Meeting of the Minds → generate a [mental] resource. Hero Response: After you play a [[Psionic]] card, ready Meeting of the Minds. (Limit three times per phase.)

name: Psychic Levitation
text: Moondragon gets +1 DEF and gains the [[Aerial]] trait. Hero Response: After Moondragon defends and takes no damage, exhaust Psychic Levitation → shuffle 1 card from your discard pile into your deck.

flavor: “I want to see it all. Know it all. Everything you are. Show me the Dark Side. Show me the Dragon.” –Phyla-Vell
name: Battle-Born Love
text: Team-Up (Moondragon and Phyla-Vell). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Search your deck and discard pile for a hero-specific card and add it to your hand. (Shuffle.)
